Class UDFFillSources

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.UDFFillSources
@Component public class UDFFillSources extends Object
The fill sources this instance offers, each with the data types of a field it can fill, and the resolvers of the fill source RESOLVER. The edit form builds its selections from this offer only, and the save validation refuses every other combination.

    • getOffered

      public List<UDFFillSourceOption> getOffered()
      Returns the offered fill sources. RESOLVER is offered for the union of the data types of the resolvers and is missing when no resolver exists. LLM is always offered: a field without a language model of the tenant of its owner keeps its values but is not processed, see UDFFillService.isProcessed.

    • getOffered

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the offer, or empty when this instance does not offer the source
